announcement: A little story. A whole world of imagination.

faqs.question: What is Hey Kahani?
faqs.answer: Hey Kahani is a screen-free audio storytelling experience for children, with stories rooted in South Asian cultures. Physical Koel story cards bring stories to life on the Kahani Player.

faqs.question: How does a Koel work?
faqs.answer: Choose a Koel, tap it on the Kahani Player, and listen. Each physical Koel is associated with a collection of individual audio stories.

faqs.question: What does the Kahani mobile app do?
faqs.answer: The companion app supports device setup and parent-facing functions. Children listen to stories on the Kahani Player.

faqs.question: Who is it for?
faqs.answer: Hey Kahani is designed primarily for children ages 3–6. Individual story and Koel age guidance will be shown when confirmed.

faqs.question: Is there a recurring subscription?
faqs.answer: The experience is designed around owned story content, with no recurring subscription.

faqs.question: What is in the Founder’s Bundle?
faqs.answer: The proposed bundle in the project SOW includes one Kahani Player, two physical Koels (Daily Life and Festivals), and 20 individual stories. Final bundle contents and pricing are awaiting confirmation.

faqs.question: Can I order from this preview?
faqs.answer: This is a frontend design preview. Ordering, shipping, returns, warranty details, and newsletter signup will be available after the Shopify store is connected and the content is approved.
